titleEn: Minimum Number of Operations to Reinitialize a Permutation
title: 还原排列的最少操作步数
summary: 偶数 n 的排列按指定奇偶下标规则反复重排，求首次恢复初始排列的操作次数。
insight: 只跟踪初始值 1 的位置即可；一次变换后，旧位置偶数映射为 position/2，奇数映射为 n/2+(position-1)/2。它回到一时整个排列周期结束。
pitfalls: 跟踪的是元素位置的映射

solutions.title: 单位置周期模拟
solutions.idea: 排列变换的整体周期等于元素一的位置周期。
steps: do 根据 position 奇偶更新位置，operations++

code.java: class Solution { public int reinitializePermutation(int n){int position=1,operations=0;do{position=position%2==0?position/2:n/2+(position-1)/2;operations++;}while(position!=1);return operations;} }
code.kotlin: class Solution { fun reinitializePermutation(n:Int):Int{var position=1;var operations=0;do{position=if(position%2==0)position/2 else n/2+(position-1)/2;operations++}while(position!=1);return operations} }
code.cpp: class Solution { public: int reinitializePermutation(int n){int position=1,operations=0;do{position=position%2? n/2+(position-1)/2:position/2;++operations;}while(position!=1);return operations;} };
